result.summary: The page is generally well structured, but the promotional banner has a significant readability issue due to very low text contrast.

issues.description: The white headline and especially the smaller promo-code text in the pale mint delivery banner have insufficient contrast against the background, making them difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a darker text color or darken the banner background/overlay to meet accessible contrast requirements while preserving the promotion styling.

issues.description: The horizontally scrolling category and restaurant rows show partially cut-off items at the right edge, including a truncated restaurant name ('Trattoria Piccol...'). This can look like accidental clipping rather than an intentional carousel.
issues.suggestion: Add clearer carousel affordances, such as consistent padding, a fade/gradient edge treatment, or a visible scroll indicator; ensure title truncation uses a deliberate ellipsis style.
